current.text: Poole is probably out of the rotation in New Orleans.

The Pelicans have a crowded rotation of about eight players who could start: Fears, Murray, Jones, Murphy, Zion, Bey, Missi and Queen. Bennedict Mathurin was added to the bench. Poole is not named in that group.
Dejounte Murray is locked in as a starting guard. The other open starting spot goes to Jeremiah Fears or Herb Jones.

durable.text: One expert admits he gets Poole wrong all the time, so expert calls on him carry extra uncertainty.

note: Poole is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 186 and ESPN ranks him 240, both value him at 0 USD, and our league paid 10 USD for him last season. Both sites project a small role (10.9 to 13.2 PTS) and he is weak in FG% (41.0%) and REB. His only real help would be FT% and some threes. Leave him on waivers and check in the first weeks whether he gets real minutes in the crowded New Orleans guard group, for example after an injury.
